description.narrative: Tematiskt är de föreslagna verksamheterna indelade i åtta områden som omfattar expert- och analysstöd för utformning, genomförande och övervakning av kritiska reformer som upprätthåller rättsstatsprincipen och demokratiska värden och stöder Ukrainas europeiska och euroatlantiska integration, stabilisering och återhämtning av landet, vars institutioner och infrastruktur drabbas hårt av det pågående ryska anfallskriget: 1. Stöd till reformen av parlamentet och förbättring av kvaliteten på den övergripande lagstiftningsprocessen i Ukraina. 2. Stärka femokratin och främja rättsstatsprincipen 3. Stöd till reformen av den offentliga förvaltningen, effektiviteten hos Ukrainas regering och presidentkansliet. 4. Stöd till stabilisering och återuppbyggnad av Ukraina. 5. Stöd till reformer inom rättsväsendet och säkerhetssektorn. 6. Medborgerlig och politisk utbildning för att främja rättsstatsprincipen och demokratiska värden. 7. Faktiska och ad hoc-analyser av ALI:s expertområden. 8. Utveckling av organisationens institutionella kapacitet som en seriell tankesmedja.

Thematically, the proposed activities are grouped into eight areas covering the expert and analytical support for the design, implementation and monitoring of critical reforms upholding the rule of law and democratic values and supporting European and Euro-Atlantic integration of Ukraine, stabilisation and recovery of the country, which institutions and infrastructure are being severely affected by the on-going russian war of aggression: 1. Support for the Parliamentary Reform and improvement of the quality of the overall legislative process in Ukraine. 2. Strengthening femocracy and promoting rule of law. 3. Support for the Public Administration Reform, the effectiveness of the Government and the Office of the President of Ukraine. 4. Support for stabilisation and reconstruction of Ukraine. 5. Support for reforms in the justice and security sectors. 6. Civic and political education, promoting the rule of law and democratic values. 7. Actual and ad hoc analytics on ALI’s areas of expertise. 8. Development of institutional capacity of the Organisation as a serial think tank.

title.narrative: Agreement Agency for Legislative Initiatives - II, 2024-2027
Decision Agency for Legislative Initiatives - II, 2024-2027

description.narrative:
Parliamentary Reform & Legislative Process (Area I)100% of requests from the Parliament and Government were supported by ALI. Two semi-annual monitoring reports and 4 Parliament Journal issues published. Support provided for Code of Ethics draft law, business continuity planning, and IT strategy development. 16 Legislative Impact Assessments (LIAs) supported; over 36 staff trained on gender-sensitive LIA. Functional analysis of VRU continuity under emergency conditions conducted and presented.
2. EU & NATO Integration (Area II)
ALI supported 8 key stakeholder requests on compliance with EU/NATO standards. Provided input for national roadmaps on democratic institutions and justice. Produced three green book policy papers on NATO legislative alignment.
Co-cordinated a consortium of CSOs to prepare Shadow Report on Chapter 23 Justice and Fundamental Rights of the European Commissions Report on Ukraine in 2023 (ali_shadowreport_chapter23_eng.pdf).
3. Public Administration Reform (Area III)
Developed a monitoring concept for government policy implementation. Roadmap development for public administration reform underway through EU negotiations. Activities on civil service studies and institutional capacity postponed to Year 2/3.
4. Stabilisation & Reconstruction (Area IV)
10 social recovery roadmaps developed for war-affected communities in 5 regions. 2 final reports on social service restoration completed. Published a shadow report on veterans' policy; presented to Ministers. Supported 8 working group meetings on the Urban Planning Code.
5. Justice & Security Reform (Area V)
Judiciary reform research initiated; 3 studies in progress (e.g., Public Integrity Council). Watchers.Media published: 80 trial reports, 39 war crime coverage pieces, 120 media articles (2 international). Supported 5 women legislators with expert advice and facilitated a study visit to Canadian legislature.
6. Civic & Political Education (Area VI)
Ukrainian School of Political Studies (USPS) ran national and alumni programmes. 70 participants trained (51 women, 19 men). USPS hosted 8 alumni events, including 5 thematic clubs on de-occupation and governance.
7. Thematic & Ad Hoc Analytics (Area VII)
ALI provided timely, responsive analytics to evolving reform needs and legislative demands.
8. Organisational Development (Area VIII)
Advanced work on analytical, communications, and managerial capacity. Upgraded internal infrastructure and transparency protocols.
The Government of Ukraine has actively utilized the Agency for Legislative Initiatives (ALI) analytical products, policy advice, and expert support in advancing institutional reformsparticularly in the context of Public Administration Reform (PAR), judicial modernization, and EU integration alignment.
Public Administration Reform (PAR): ALIs annual Shadow Reports on PAR Implementation have served as independent assessments complementing the Governments official monitoring. Findings and recommendations from ALIs reports have been incorporated into the Governments updated PAR Strategy 20222025, including measures on performance evaluation of civil servants and digitalization of HR systems (HRMIS). Ministries and the Secretariat of the Cabinet of Ministers used ALIs evidence-based analyses to design reform monitoring frameworks.
EU Integration and Legislative Alignment: Since Ukraines recognition as an EU candidate in 2022, ALIs expertise has guided the Government Office for European and Euro-Atlantic Integration and Verkhovna Rada committees in shaping negotiating positions for EU accession. ALI experts have been directly engaged in five governmental working groups drafting Ukraines EU negotiation chapters, influencing official positions in areas such as Justice and Fundamental Rights and Public Administration Reform.
Judicial and Constitutional Reform: Recommendations from ALIs functional and institutional analyses of the Constitutional Court and High Council of Justice were used to refine digitalization strategies and streamline internal governance. The Constitutional Court incorporated ALIs recommendations into its 20242026 modernization plan, particularly regarding electronic case management systems.
In sum, ALIs contributions go beyond analysisthey shape government decisions, policies, and institutional reforms, serving as a bridge between evidence-based research and policy implementation in Ukraines ongoing democratic transformation and EU integration process.
Closing Notes
Despite war conditions, ALI effectively adapted and exceeded targets in key areas. Several activities were postponed strategically due to stakeholder timelines and ongoing war.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
